summary: Enhance your skills with our Financial Data Review and Fraud Detection Training Course. Learn to identify fraud and analyze financial data effectively.
lede: Financial data review and fraud detection gives finance, audit, risk, and compliance professionals a structured way to examine records for suspicious patterns and control gaps. Practical work covers transaction and journal-entry testing, spreadsheet-based anomaly screening, vendor and payment checks, evidence tracing, and documenting exceptions for escalation.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who review financial records, investigate exceptions, and strengthen fraud controls across finance, audit, risk, and compliance functions.
prerequisites: Prerequisites required: working familiarity with financial statements, journal entries, accounts payable or receivable processes, and basic internal control concepts. No coding is required for completion, although comfort using Excel or a comparable spreadsheet tool will help you complete the review exercises more efficiently. The course is suitable for foundation to intermediate learners, with advanced analytics topics covered at conceptual and operational application level rather than engineering depth.
